name: Agent Performance dashboard: cards, table row equals the agent's Stats tab, empty custom range
description: From /agents click the sidebar 'Agent Performance' item: the four summary cards and the per-agent table render (sorted by Runs descending). The Security Reviewer row's Runs, Avg cost and Avg duration texts are read and kept in sessionStorage, 'View' opens /agents/<id>?tab=stats&from=..&to=.. and the Stats tab must show the same three values for the same window (values are compared with each other, not with absolute counts, because the seed has a single done run with no cost). Then a custom range in 2001 shows the empty state 'No agent runs in this period' with the applied UTC period and no table. Read-only: only GET requests, no model call. Needs the fixture seed (PROJECT_DOCS_SOURCE=fixture) so the Security Reviewer has its one seeded done run in the last 30 days (see e2e/README.md).

cmd: (() => { const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('article h3')].map((x) => x.textContent.trim()); return ['Total runs', 'Total cost', 'Avg accept rate', 'Most-active agent'].every((l) => h.some((x) => x.startsWith(l))); })()
steps.label: the four summary cards render
the Security Reviewer row renders in the table
the table is sorted by Runs descending by default

cmd: (() => { const c = ([...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="agent-name"]')].find((e) => e.textContent.trim() === 'Security Reviewer').closest('tr')).cells; sessionStorage.setItem('ap-row', JSON.stringify([c[1].textContent.trim(), c[2].textContent.trim(), c[3].textContent.trim()])); return sessionStorage.getItem('ap-row'); })()
steps.label: remember the row's runs, avg cost and avg duration texts
click View on the Security Reviewer row
the agent page opens on the Stats tab
the dashboard window travels in the URL

cmd: (() => { const [runs, cost, dur] = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('ap-row') || '[]'); const tab = document.querySelector('[data-testid="agent-stats-tab"]'); if (!tab || runs === undefined) return false; if (runs === '0') return tab.textContent.includes('No runs in this period'); const val = (label) => { const dt = [...tab.querySelectorAll('dt')].find((d) => d.textContent.trim().startsWith(label)); return dt ? dt.nextElementSibling.textContent.trim() : null; }; return val('RUNS') === runs && val('AVG COST/RUN') === cost && val('AVG DURATION') === dur; })()
